order_constraints.scope: AncGR1.0 background; p1546 Fig2A mutational paths
order_constraints.evidence: Fig2A green probable path introduces L111Q before S106P. S106P-first markedly reduces response to all ligands. This is a relative plausibility constraint, not observed historical timing or an absolute prohibition.

order_constraints.scope: Functional paths on AncGR1.0 background; atomic groups as assayed
order_constraints.evidence: Fig3A assays all eight group combinations. Full Y abolishes function unless X and Z are present. Paper infers X and Z preceded completion of Y. No order between X and Z; no claim that every X/Z member precedes every Y member.

order_constraints.scope: AncCR->AncGR1.0 precedes AncGR1.0->AncGR2; branch-level precedence only
order_constraints.evidence: Y27R maps to the earlier reconstructed branch and reversal abolishes activity in the XYZ background. It is not necessary to infer a residue-level order inside the later branch.
order_constraints.locator: Ortlund2007 p1547 Fig4A-B; Bridgham2009 p515 Fig1 and pp516-517 group W

order_constraints.evidence: W strongly reduces sensitivity in x backgrounds and has weak/moderate benefit in X backgrounds. Authors infer W probably was not complete before X remodeling. This does not order every W member after both X members.
order_constraints.locator: Bridgham2009 p517 main text and p518 Fig4B

order_constraints.scope: Whole-block paths in assayed AncGR2 reversal cube; not all W residues individually necessary
order_constraints.evidence: Restoring x is strongly impaired without w; fully ancestral conformation restoration also requires reversal of Y. Reversing W alone does not restore ancestral phenotype. No forward chronology is automatically derived from this reversal result. Single Y107A or paired W reversions partially rescue the impaired receptor; do not require all five W reversions before every X member.

C71S alone has negligible sensitivity effect but buffers the double desensitizing mutant. Authors explicitly conjecture it occurred before V43A and R116H. Individual desensitizing substitutions remain active; this is not directly measured historical order.

order_constraints.scope: Assayed whole-block paths starting at AncGR2 XYZW only
order_constraints.evidence: Reverting W alone is nonfunctional; reversing Y first allows viable later W reversal. Z is not assigned a unique position. This is not an individual-residue or observed historical order.

order_status.backgrounds: 2007/2009 AncGR1.0 and 2011 AncGR1.1 are different reconstructions of the same node. They must remain separate benchmarks. Example: later W event A107Y assumes AncGR1.0 Ala107, whereas 2011 early event A107S yields Ser107.
order_status.scoring: Score only explicit applicable constraints with matching reconstruction background. Do not score an arbitrary total order, expand group completion into all pairwise edges, or treat author conjecture as direct chronological observation.

missing_for_validation: Codon-aligned exact reconstructed endpoints for each version, with reconstruction uncertainty/protein provenance, are not currently model-alignment rows. Synonymous historical codons are not established by these protein-level reconstructions.
A curated deletion-aware crosswalk is required at Anc211/212; deleted Ser212 must have modern coordinate null and be represented by ancestral/alignment column or indel unit.

Archive and inspect Ortlund2007 supplement (especially TableS4, FigsS5-S6, full ancestral sequences/assays) and Bridgham2009 Supplementary Figs1-5; these are not present under data/experimental. Main paper supports listed groups but not exhaustive site-level genotype viability.
Specify phenotype, ligand/dose, activation cutoff and matching experimental background when converting sensitivity into viable-path labels; low sensitivity is not categorically nonfunctional.
No original study establishes a unique complete order across every substituted site. Most intra-group orderings and the remaining later-branch sites have no temporal ground truth.
A scoring adapter must compare group-completion and conditional/reverse constraints, keep 2011 conjectural precedence separate, and support not_testable for unassayed site pairs.
Modern7PRX is a useful residue-location scaffold but carries a nonsteroidal ligand and additional divergence; it cannot reproduce historical genotype-dependent conformational causality alone.
corrections_to_existing: SR3 omits restrictive W membership and actual reversal prerequisite; reversal of W with XYZ restored to ancestral states substantially rescues ancestral response.
SR4 and known_limitations incorrectly cap order evidence at seven/eight changes; Bridgham2009 adds five W sites and 2011 adds a separate early interval with three key sites.
S212del currently listed as modern742 is invalid homology; modern742 is an extant Asp beside the deleted region, not a replacement state for deleted Ser212.
S106P/L111Q Fig2A includes a preferred internal path (L111Q first); current registry only records epistasis.
Carroll2011 is cited but substantive key targets V43A, R116H, C71S and conjectured buffering-first order are missing.
Do not describe the 2011 AncGR1.1 reconstruction/3RY9 as the 2007 AncGR1.0 endpoint. The early branch differs: 2007 reports25 substitutions; 2011 updated reconstruction reports36.
All-combination Fig3A includes AncGR1+XZ and AncGR1+YZ; current assayed_genotypes list omits these.
Claim that all later interval substitutions other than X/Y/Z were never assayed is wrong: 2009 W was assayed.
A36G is not Thr36; Table1 lists effects by magnitude, which is not temporal substitution order.
local_endpoint_note: AA FASTAs and posterior_probabilities.json already exist under data/sequences/ancestral. AncGR1.fa is labeled Carroll2011 ML; verify reconstruction version against each 2007/2009/2011 source before use. They are not codon-aligned ancestral model rows.
